distribution.title: The purpose of the data collection is to analyse the well-being experiences of mature-age students enrolled in STEM higher education programmes in Latvia and to compare them with international institutional practices. The data support the project objectives of developing a validated well-being model and generating evidence-based policy and institutional recommendations. Primary data originate from quantitative surveys and qualitative semi-structured interviews conducted with mature-age students. Secondary contextual data (institutional and policy documents) are used to complement the analysis. The collected data form the empirical basis for scientific publications, policy recommendations, and a methodological tool.

dataset.title: RTU DMP

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan (DMP) outlines the procedures for collecting, processing, storing, protecting, and sharing research data generated within the project “Well-being experiences of mature-age students in higher education in the context of diversity”. The project applies a mixed-methods approach (survey and qualitative interviews) to analyse well-being dimensions of mature-age STEM students in Latvia and in comparative international context. The DMP ensures that all research data are managed in accordance with FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable), ethical research standards, and GDPR requirements, while enabling appropriate long-term preservation, controlled access to sensitive materials, and open dissemination of anonymised datasets and research outputs.
